severity.LOW: Informational or cosmetic; no data/security impact
severity.MEDIUM: User operation failed but retry/recovery is normally safe
severity.HIGH: Core operation failed or data state may need reconciliation
severity.CRITICAL: Security, authorization, data integrity, or cross-client access risk

KKA-AUTH-0001.title: Authentication failed
KKA-AUTH-0001.userMessage: We could not sign you in. Please verify your details and try again.
KKA-AUTH-0001.adminAction: Check authentication logs and account status.

KKA-AUTH-0002.title: Authentication service unavailable
KKA-AUTH-0002.userMessage: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

KKA-SESSION-0001.title: Session expired
KKA-SESSION-0001.userMessage: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
KKA-SESSION-0001.adminAction: Verify session refresh and expiry configuration.

KKA-SESSION-0002.title: Session state inconsistent
KKA-SESSION-0002.userMessage: Your session could not be verified. Please sign in again.
KKA-SESSION-0002.adminAction: Check auth state, browser storage, and session-security logs.

KKA-SEC-0001.title: Authorization denied
KKA-SEC-0001.userMessage: You are not authorized to perform this action.
KKA-SEC-0001.adminAction: Verify role, membership, RLS and server-side authorization. Treat repeated cross-client attempts as a security incident.

KKA-SEC-0002.title: Cross-client access attempt blocked
KKA-SEC-0002.userMessage: The requested resource is not available.
KKA-SEC-0002.adminAction: Immediately inspect user, client ID, document ID and authorization logs.

KKA-DOC-0001.title: Document not found
KKA-DOC-0001.userMessage: The document could not be found.
KKA-DOC-0001.adminAction: Verify document ID, status, deletion state and storage object.

KKA-DOC-0002.title: Document access failed
KKA-DOC-0002.userMessage: We could not open this document.
KKA-DOC-0002.adminAction: Verify client ownership, document status, access function and storage object.

KKA-UPL-0001.title: Unsupported file
KKA-UPL-0001.userMessage: This file type is not supported.
KKA-UPL-0001.adminAction: Verify extension, MIME mapping and upload allow-list.

KKA-UPL-0002.title: Upload transfer failed
KKA-UPL-0002.userMessage: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again.
KKA-UPL-0002.adminAction: Check network, signed upload URL, storage bucket and file size.

KKA-UPL-0003.title: Upload completion failed
KKA-UPL-0003.userMessage: The file was transferred but could not be finalized. Reference the error code when contacting KKA.
KKA-UPL-0003.adminAction: Check upload ID, completion function logs, document row and storage object. Reconcile before retrying repeatedly.

KKA-UPL-0004.title: Duplicate document
KKA-UPL-0004.adminAction: Verify SHA-256 duplicate detection and existing document record.

KKA-STORAGE-0001.title: Storage object unavailable
KKA-STORAGE-0001.userMessage: The document storage service could not provide this file.
KKA-STORAGE-0001.adminAction: Verify storage object/path, bucket policy and storage service status.

KKA-DB-0001.title: Database operation failed
KKA-DB-0001.userMessage: We could not complete this operation. Please try again.
KKA-DB-0001.adminAction: Inspect database error, transaction state, constraints and RLS. Check whether the operation partially committed.

KKA-OD-0001.title: OneDrive operation failed
KKA-OD-0001.userMessage: The document could not be synchronized with KKA storage.
KKA-OD-0001.adminAction: Check Microsoft Graph credentials, destination path, OneDrive availability and function logs.

KKA-OD-0002.title: OneDrive location mismatch
KKA-OD-0002.userMessage: The document location could not be resolved.
KKA-OD-0002.adminAction: Compare filing-node hierarchy with stored document metadata. Do not rewrite historical documents without verification.

KKA-ADMIN-0001.title: Administrative operation failed
KKA-ADMIN-0001.userMessage: The administrative operation could not be completed.
KKA-ADMIN-0001.adminAction: Inspect operation audit entry and server response before retrying.

KKA-SYS-0001.title: Unexpected application error
KKA-SYS-0001.userMessage: Something went wrong. Reference the error code when contacting KKA support.
KKA-SYS-0001.adminAction: Use the correlation/request ID to trace browser, Edge Function, database and storage logs.

KKA-SYS-0002.title: Network request failed
KKA-SYS-0002.userMessage: The network request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
